'''Outpost C-1''' was an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] [[Listening post/Legends|listening post]] located in the [[Carba Asteroid Belt]] in the [[Bacrana system/Legends|Bacrana system]]. It was staffed entirely by [[Droid/Legends|droids]]. During [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] sweeps, the entire base shut down to avoid detection. The droids collected data and sent it to [[Oracle Base]] at regular intervals via the use of [[Hyperdrive pod/Legends|hyperspace pod]].
